description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the UserService class within the OrangeHRM system. It contains various test methods to verify user-related functionalities such as saving users, password verification, credentials retrieval, and undeletable user IDs. The class extends KernelTestCase and uses mocking to simulate dependencies.

classes.name: UserServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for the UserService, testing user creation, password validation, credentials fetching, and undeletable IDs within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the UserService instance for testing.

methods.name: getUserRole
methods.description: Creates and returns a UserRole object with preset ID and names for testing.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserNoPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user without changing the password, ensuring the same object is returned.

methods.name: testSaveSystemUserWithPasswordChange
methods.description: Tests saving a user with a new password, verifying the password is hashed properly.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordUserNotFound
methods.description: Verifies behavior when checking the password for a user that does not exist.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordTrue
methods.description: Checks if the password verification returns true for correct credentials.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordWithNullPassword
methods.description: Verifies behavior when the user has a null password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordOldHash
methods.description: Tests password verification with an old md5 hash password.

methods.name: testIsCurrentPasswordFalse
methods.description: Checks that false is returned when password verification fails.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsUserNotFound
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned when user credentials do not match any user.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsValidPassword
methods.description: Checks correct user retrieval when valid password is provided.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsOldHash
methods.description: Tests that user credentials are upgraded from an old md5 hash to a secure hash upon login.

methods.name: testGetCredentialsInvalidPassword
methods.description: Verifies that null is returned for incorrect passwords.

methods.name: testGetUndeletableUserIds
methods.description: Verifies the functionality for retrieving IDs of users that cannot be deleted.
